about: I represent clients in high-stakes personal injury and commercial litigation across Texas.

I am a Texas trial lawyer. Over the last 20 years, my firm has recovered more than $200,000,000 in verdicts and settlements . I take on the big fights for people severely injured in 18-wheeler crashes, business owners caught in commercial disputes, and building owners facing construction defects.

I handle cases from start to finish across the state. I litigate aggressively in Houston, San Antonio, Corpus Christi, and the Rio Grande Valley. I know how both sides think—before founding my own firm, I rose to partner during my first decade of practice and represented dozens of school districts and cities across Texas.
Other attorneys come to me when they have a complex case they want handled right. Referrals make up a significant part of my practice because other lawyers trust my track record.

I have been named a " Texas Super Lawyer " in 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026. I was selected as a Top 100 Houston Super Lawyer in 2025 and 2026. I was named a "Texas Rising Star" in 2015 and 2016, and a Houstonia Top Lawyer and Legal Leaders Texas Top Rated Lawyer in 2015. I am a Fellow of the College of the State Bar of Texas, having maintained my membership for 14 consecutive years in 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026.

I hold the highest possible rating from Martindale-Hubbell (AV Preeminent) and carry a 10.0 Superb Avvo rating . My professional memberships include the Million Dollar Advocates Forum , the Garland R. Walker American Inn of Court, The National Trial Lawyers Top 100 , the American Association for Justice, the Texas Trial Lawyers Association, the Houston Trial Lawyers Association, and the Academy of Truck Accident Attorneys. Additionally, my firm is a BBB Accredited Business with an A+ rating. Perfect 5 Star Google Rating .

My drive started early—working night shifts and earning a technical certification before making the Dean's List at the University of Texas from 1999 to 2002. I went on to graduate from the University of Houston Law Center, where I served as Research Editor for the Journal of International Law.
I regularly advise other legal professionals on personal injury strategies, firm management, and how to effectively integrate the latest AI technology into a modern legal practice.

I help people and businesses get the financial recovery they need to move forward. Some of the cases I handle include wrongful death, traumatic brain injuries, premises liability, insurance bad faith, and commercial disputes. My construction defect practice exclusively represents building owners. If you have a serious case that needs attention, I am a phone call away at 866-265-2948 .
